title: Nagano — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Nagano: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Nagano has a population of 380,000. Host of the 1998 Winter Olympics, surrounded by the Japanese Alps with world-class skiing, temples, and hot springs. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 92 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.

Last updated: November 07, 2026
